_method: Track filenames are deliberately obfuscated (place names, not instrument names) by the original release. This mapping was built automatically, not by listening: scripts/ml_vocal_check.py (vocal-isolation-model energy ratio) decided vocal vs. non-vocal, then scripts/classify_tracks.py's percussive-ratio/low-frequency-energy features split the remainder into drums/bass/other. Cross-checked against the few filenames that happen to leak a hint ('field_drum_pa' -> drums, 'february_base' -> bass) as a sanity check, not as the basis for the classification itself. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
